translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Paeyi we Epeo
Nee oatosoraei Sunday, igiwe e rhiuwen pwoong, nge Maria Magdalene a noa reen paeyi we, iwe nge a noa weri pwe fai we tittin aesemaen paeyi we a mwagiut saengi miniwe nenien.
A fattapw noa reen Simon Peter me rhooan kkayeo we erhai, mwaaen we Jesus e igin aerhaengi, nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Ra pwigi noa Soamwoon me noan paeyi we, nge aeise giuneei igine ra pwigi noa ee!”
Iwe Peter me rhooan kkayeo we erhai ra noa reen paeyi we.
Iir me riiurhai nge re fattapw ppag noa, nge rhooan kkayeo we erhai enang me mmwaen Peter, iwe a gommwonoa gona paeyi we.
A pwoar tiw iwe a weri mengaag pwerhepwerh kkewe, iwe nge ese teogach nong noan paeyi we.
Simon Peter epwan mwiriy to, e itto rhag itto teeo foar nong noan paeyi we. A weri mengaag pwerhepwerh kkewe pwe ewon
fengaen me mengaag we geeogeeon rhimwen Jesus. Ese rhunong neeiin mengaag kkewe aaemweoi pwe iiy e oawunnu noa rhag.
Nge iwe rhooan kkayeo we erhai, iwe egommwaen gonoa paeyi we, iiy a pwan toonong; a weri iwe a niugiuniug. (
Resaaen metefaaegini mwo reen miniwe eno noan Pwapwior we e Santus iwe e iura pwe iiy epwe menaw saengi mae noa.)
Iwe rhag nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra pwan sefaaen noa nee pwuguseer.
Jesus a Pwae Ngaeni Maria Magdalene
Maria e rhiuwen iu saeng niugiun paeyi we. Igiwe e rhiuwen sessaeng, a pwoar tiw pwe a fan nong noan paeyi we
iwe a weriir riiurhai angkenus re mengaag pwerh ffat noa rhag, remooat igiwe eno miniwe oanongaen Jesus ee, erhai emooat reen rhimwen nge erhai reen pirheen.
Ra aeiineow pwe, “Rhooapwut mwuun, meeta wosaeng reen?” A paniuwaeniir pwe, “Ra pwigi noa aaei Soamwoon nge ise giuneei igine ra pwigi noa ee!”
Enoa toagun sefaaen nge a weri Jesus pwe e iu igiwe; nge ese giuneei pwe Jesus.

Jesus a aeiineow pwe, “Rhooapwut mwuun, meeta wosaeng reen? Iyo mwu wo kiukkiutta?” Niewe e niuwaennei pwe rhooan maat we, iwe a aengaeni pwe, “Menap, ngaere wa pwigi noa iwe nge wopwe aengaeniaei igine wonoa iseni noa ee, pwe ipwe noa iya noa pwigi.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Maria!” Niewe a toagun ngaeni nge a iura noan kkepesaen Hebrew pwe “Rabboni!” (Faan nge “Sinsei”.)

Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Wosoapw kkemwarh tae wooai, pwe ngaang isaaen ittae mwo reen miniwe Semaei. Iwe nge wopwe sefaaen noa reer rhooawe pwiiy nge wa aengaeniir pwe ngaang ipwene sefaaen noa reen miniwe Semaei me Semeer, aaei Deus me aar Deus.”
Maria Magdalene a noa aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe pwe a weri Soamwoon, nge a pwan aengaeniir meeta we Soamwoon e aengaeni.
Jesus a Pwae Ngaeniir Rhooan Kkayeo Kkewe Naiun

A nee oatofaaef noan iiy Sunday we, nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra mweoiu fengaen, iwe ra noakkei noa asam pwe igiwe re mesagiiur Soamwoonin Jews kkewe. Jesus a itto iunoa neeiir, nge a iura pwe, “Oapoas epwe no reemi.”
Mwirin aan aepesa minneei nge a pwaeri ngaeniir noan paiun me miniwe wenepeigin. Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra igin kker tae igiwe ra weri Soamwoon.
Jesus a pwan aengaeniir pwe, “Oapoas epwe no reemi. Taeppen Semaei a fangeto ngaang, iwe ngaang iya fangenoa aaemi.”
Iwe Jesus a nngastiw wooar iwe nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Epwe no Espritu Santus woami.
Aere oaw saeneti monofitiir aeremas nge epwe saenetaeg; nge aere oawse saeneti nge esoapw saenetaeg.”
Jesus me Thomas
Erhai me neeiir rhooa kkayeo kkewe seig me riiurhai itan Thomas (iwe regaen iura Nippwei), e soano reer reen oatowe Jesus e itto.

Rhooan kkayeo kkewe aaemweoi ra aengaeni pwe, “Aeiya weri Soamwoon!” Thomas aengaeniir pwe, “Aekkaen igine iweri nepeyin kinesaen chiufan kkewe noan paiun nge iya aeitinong aiuttiuy noan ginesaen paiun me tugunong noan ginas we wenepeigin, iwe nge ipwe naaen niugiuniug.”

Enoa eew week me mwirin, rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra pwan rhu fengaen me nee iimw, iwe nge Thomas a no reer. Asam kkewe nge e noak, iwe nge Jesus e itto a itto iunoa neeiir nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oapoas epwe no reemi.”

Nge a aengaeni Thomas pwe, “Aeiti nong aiuttiumw iga, iwe wa pipiiy minikka paeyi; iwe nge wa aeitito poawumw pwe wopwe tugunong noan minne wenepeigi. Wone iugiu noa mwo me oamw se niugiuniug, iwe wone niugiuniug!”
Thomas a paniuwaeni pwe, “Aaei Soamwoon nge aaei Deus!”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Wo niugiuniug rhag iga woweriaei? Ifa mwo aar kker rhooakka re niugiuniug nge rese weriaei!”
Ipitan Pwapwior Ieen
Egin towunap kkeman kka Jesus a feeori weni mmweer rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ikka ese foat noan pwapwior eei.
Iwe nge ikkeei a foatotiw pwe aegin pwe oawpwe niugiuniug pwe Jesus minne Kristus, Naiun Deus, iwe nge noan aaemi niugiuniug ngaeni oawpwe weri menaw.
